Calling all innovators - find your future at Fiserv. 
 
 We're Fiserv, a global leader in Fintech and payments, and we move money and information in a way that moves the world. We connect financial institutions, corporations, merchants and consumers to one another millions of times a day - quickly, reliably, and securely. Any time you swipe your credit card, pay through a mobile app, or withdraw money from the bank, we're involved. If you want to make an impact on a global scale, come make a difference at Fiserv.
 
 
 Job Title 
Android Application Framework Developer - Device Engineering 
 
 About Your Role 
 Clover is a global leader in point-of-sale (POS) platforms powering millions of small businesses worldwide with integrated hardware, software, and secure payment solutions. We are seeking a highly energized, disciplined, and tech-passionate Android Application Framework Developer to join our Device Engineering team in Sunnyvale, CA. In this high-impact systems role, you will help build, certify, and operate Clover’s next-generation Android-based smart terminal devices. You will bridge the gap between high-level Android applications and low-level hardware, taking direct ownership of core Android framework services, POS peripheral integration, and hardware communication architectures. If you thrive in an agile environment alongside like-minded, highly skilled engineers and are excited about building software that interacts directly with physical devices, we want to talk to you! 

 What You Will Do 
 Android Framework & Hardware Integration: Design and build Android application framework services and background daemons that directly interface with external hardware peripherals, payment kernels, and low-level microcontrollers. 
 Peripheral Architecture & Vendor SDKs: Integrate POS vendor SDKs and build robust communication pipelines for external hardware including receipt printers, cash drawers, barcode scanners, and weighing scales. 
 USB & Network Protocol Management: Manage Android USB OTG Host APIs, handle USB attach/detach events, manage dynamic USB hardware permissions, and implement socket programming for network-connected peripherals. 
 System Infrastructure & Data Sync: Add new capabilities to core platform infrastructure and services, ensuring low-latency, sub-second data synchronization and communication across diverse terminal device types. 
 Defect Triage & Troubleshooting: Investigate, isolate, and resolve complex system integration issues, OS regressions, and hardware peripheral bugs across production devices. 
 Cross-Functional Certification & Product Alignment: Partner with product management to refine technical specifications and collaborate directly with international certification teams and hardware test labs. 
 Production Reliability: Participate in a regular on-call rotation to provide production support and maintain fleet-wide device health. 
 AI-First Engineering: Apply an AI-first mindset, leveraging AI-powered development tools (such as Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, and coding agents) to accelerate framework development, optimize infrastructure, and streamline root-cause analysis. 
 
 What You Need to Have 
 Experience & Mindset: 2+ years of professional software development experience with a strong focus on Android platform architecture, framework design, and a genuine eagerness to learn and innovate in POS device engineering. 
 Android Application & Framework Depth: Hands-on experience developing native Android applications and background services in Kotlin and Java, with proven experience communicating with external physical hardware. 
 USB & Networking Protocols: Practical proficiency with Android USB Host APIs (USB OTG), managing USB device permissions/events, and socket programming for network IP printers and hardware endpoints. 
 AOSP Language Proficiency: Proficiency in at least two major languages used in the Android stack (Kotlin, Java, C, or C++). 
 UI & Performance Optimization: Experience developing clean, performant Android UIs adapted for custom terminal screen sizes and hardware constraints. 
 Developer Tooling & Revision Control: Strong working knowledge of version control and code review tools, including Git and Gerrit. 
 Security & Cryptography Basics: Broad understanding of platform security protocols, PKI, digital certificates, encryption/decryption, and hardware-level security (HSM). 
 AI-First Fluency: Demonstrated experience leveraging AI coding tools and LLM assistants for code generation, refactoring, and debugging. 
 
 Experience that would be great to have: 
 AOSP (Android Open Source Project) Customization: Hands-on experience modifying AOSP, building custom Android system services, or working within frameworks/base/. 
 POS & Hardware Peripheral Vendor SDKs: Prior experience integrating third-party vendor SDKs for Point of Sale (POS), retail, or kiosk hardware. 
 Embedded Systems & RTOS: Familiarity with low-level microcontrollers (ARM Cortex-M/R), embedded C development, or Real-Time Operating Systems (RTOS) for inter-CPU communication protocols (SPI, UART, CAN). 
 
 How you’ll work: 
 This role is on-site Monday through Friday. Fiserv considers in-person collaboration to be an essential part of this role as in-person office experiences help you with your overall onboarding experience and leads to stronger productivity. 
 This role requires use of a computer and audio equipment. 
 
 Sponsorship: 
 You must currently possess valid and unrestricted U.S. work authorization to be considered for this role. Individuals with temporary visas including, but not limited to, F-1 (OPT, CPT, STEM), H-1B, H-2, or TN, or any candidate requiring sponsorship, now or in the future, will not be considered for this role. 
   
 Benefits at Fiserv: 
 Fuel Your Life program to support your physical, financial, social, and emotional well-being 
 Paid holidays and generous time away policies 
 No-cost mental health support through Employee Assistance Programs 
 Living Proof program to recognize your peers’ extra effort with points redeemable for rewards 
 Eight Employee Resource Groups to foster a collaborative culture and expand your network 
 ·Unparalleled professional growth with training, development, and internal mobility opportunities 
 Medical, dental, vision, life, and disability insurance options available from day one 
 Retirement planning and discounted shares with the Employee Stock Purchase Plan 
 Tuition assistance and reimbursement program 
 Paid parental, caregiver, and military leave 
 
 #LI-SH2
 
 
 Salary Range 
$124,000.00 - $186,000.00 
 
 These pay ranges apply to employees in Sunnyvale, California. Pay ranges for employees in other states may differ. 
 
 It is unlawful to discriminate against a prospective employee due to the individual's status as a veteran. 
 
 
 
This position is not eligible for an annual incentive opportunity and is also not eligible to earn commissions. 
 
 Thank you for considering employment with Fiserv.  Please: 
 
 Apply using your legal name 
 Complete the step-by-step profile and attach your resume (either is acceptable, both are preferable). 
 
 
 Our commitment to Equal Opportunity: 
 Fiserv is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, disability, protected veteran status, or any other category protected by law. 
 
 If you have a disability and require a reasonable accommodation in completing a job application or otherwise participating in the overall hiring process, please contact  AskHR.US@fiserv.com . Please note our AskHR representatives do not have visibility to your application status. Current associates who require a workplace accommodation should refer to Fiserv’s Disability Accommodation Policy for additional information.
 
 Note to agencies: 
 Fiserv does not accept resume submissions from agencies outside of existing agreements. Please do not send resumes to Fiserv associates. Fiserv is not responsible for any fees associated with unsolicited resume submissions.
 
 Warning about fake job posts: 
 Please be aware of fraudulent job postings that are not affiliated with Fiserv. Fraudulent job postings may be used by cyber criminals to target your personally identifiable information and/or to steal money or financial information. Any communications from a Fiserv representative will come from a legitimate Fiserv email address.
